title: What an ERP is and why it constrains the architecture

videos.script: Most of the software in a large company was not written by anybody who works there. {{estate}} It was bought, configured and connected, and then it was kept running for fifteen years. This course is about that world, and about the architect who has to change it without switching it off. {{serra}} We follow one company the whole way. Serra Alta is a dairy in Minas Gerais. It collects milk from nineteen hundred farms every single day, and the milk cannot wait. {{joana}} Joana Brandão has just joined as its first enterprise architect. She knows how to build systems. She is about to learn what it means to integrate them. {{erp}} This first lesson is about the system at the centre: the ERP. What it is, why it holds one database for the whole business, and how a single sale leaves a trail of documents through it. {{constraint}} Then the part that matters to an architect. The ERP decides more of your design than you do. Its data model, its calendar and its licence all reach into every system around it. {{week}} By the end of the lesson you will know why Joana's first proposal, in her second week, was turned down.
